answer: A reviewable implementation of Migration Preparation should demonstrate: Refactor a controller-heavy page into reusable components and services. Use the required API tokens only as an initial static smoke check; run the full application locally and review the acceptance criteria before considering it complete.
explanation: The required token checks are intentionally limited and do not prove correctness, accessibility, security, or runtime behavior. Test the full implementation in an isolated local browser setup, add regression tests for edge cases, and keep server-side authorization and validation on the server.
